title: Zajno Landing Page Reveal
description: An on-load intro where a centered number counts up to 100, then triggers the landing-page reveal: the scaled-down hero clip-path opens from the bottom while it scales to full size, a dark overlay wipes upward, the hero image un-zooms from scale 2 to 1, and the giant headline's per-character spans rise into place with a stagger. Driven entirely by GSAP timelines chained via onStart/onComplete callbacks, using a CustomEase named 'hop' plus power3/power4 eases.

images.desc: Retro-futurist photograph of two mission crew in orange suits watching a galaxy and Saturn through a capsule window; revealed by un-zooming from scale 2 to 1.
images.role: Bottom hero image strip inside the .hero-img frame.

images.desc: Crimson nebula (Crescent Nebula) drifting across deep space; warm cohesive tone.
images.role: First card in the Selected work grid — project 'Orbit'.

images.desc: Apollo astronaut standing on the grey lunar surface with a long shadow and golden foil.
images.role: Second card in the Selected work grid — project 'Ground Control'.

images.desc: Close-up of a vintage reel-to-reel tape machine with a red RECORD button and VU meter.
images.role: Third card in the Selected work grid — project 'Longplay'.

intent.useWhen: Cuando quieras una intro de carga con contador que da paso a un hero con revelado por clip-path y titular animado letra a letra.

motion.motion_signature: on-load counter to 100, then a hop-eased clip-path hero reveal running simultaneously with a 2.25s scale(0.7)->scale(1) un-zoom, a 2.25s image scale(2)->scale(1) push-in, an overlay clip-path wipe and a 0.1s per-character headline rise from translateY(500px); everything is time-based, no scroll or rAF physics
